blocks.text: Echoshell keeps the form of a listening vessel after the larger customs around it have compressed. Its care function survives in a shell and a pearl. The familiar shape does not remove its drawback for an already distressed pet.
An asymmetrical hollow bronze listening shell with violet enamel ribs and a suspended cream pearl.
One-shot activation: The ribs hinge outward and the pearl releases two slow concentric ripples, then holds open. The game performs the final fade.

28 silver. Chronic severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +14; Happiness +3. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes. Health +4 more if Chronic remains after treatment. Drawback: existing Stress gains 1 severity and 5 minutes. This does not create an absent condition.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation c7c05e81-ef5c-48a7-9e98-39c12b8dcf82; animation caeb2e28-35bd-4d78-a666-2201b1431df4. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
